title: Book II, Aphorisms XLIV–LII
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book II, Aphorisms XLIV–LII, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 230–290. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: The prerogative instances that aid practice: instances of the rod, of the course and of quantity, and wrestling instances, with Bacon's list of the simple motions of matter, then suggesting, generally useful and magical instances. The book closes with the uses of the twenty-seven kinds and the plan of the work still to come.
